description: This file defines utility functions and a class for setting OpenTelemetry span attributes related to Arize integration, including message, response, tool, and response attributes, for tracing LLM operations.

classes.name: ArizeOTELAttributes
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes to set OpenTelemetry attributes for Arize integration.

methods.name: set_messages
methods.description: Sets message-related span attributes based on provided messages.

methods.name: set_response_output_messages
methods.description: Sets span attributes for response messages from the LLM.

methods.name: _set_tool_attributes
methods.description: Helper to set tool and function call attributes on span.

methods.name: _set_response_attributes
methods.description: Helper to set response output and token usage attributes on span.

methods.name: set_attributes
methods.description: Main function to populate span with various LLM-related attributes for tracing.
